verdict.rationale: Maritime runs agents in per-agent micro-VMs and Linux desktops, so network egress policy is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence documents egress allow/deny rules, domain allowlists, or any network policy for the sandbox. Scoped API keys and secret injection are adjacent access controls that govern who can call Maritime, not what the VM can reach, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy
